_about: Website copy, keyed by tool id. Keep it short: tagline (a few words), problem (one or two sentences, shown when a tool is opened), bullets (about 10 words each; **bold** works). Images live in site/assets/. Set mockup to false once the image is a real screenshot.

leanback.tagline: Use your PC from the couch with a controller.
leanback.problem: Pick up a controller and Windows rearranges itself for the couch. Put it down and your desktop is back.
bullets: Turns on with your controller, off when you switch it off
Bigger text and a pointer you can see across the room
**Hold Y for a fast pointer** that crosses a big TV in a blink
Hold LT and tilt the right stick for volume or window switching
**Plays nice with Playnite, Steam Big Picture and Kodi**, handing them the controls while they're in front
**Map any button** to a key combo, or to open an app
**Finds every button on your controller**: Home, D-pad, paddles and extras
Steps aside on its own when a game starts
Monitor and TV? Only the screen you pick gets bigger
Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, 8BitDo and generic Bluetooth or 2.4 GHz pads
leanback.alt: A TV showing large, couch-friendly Windows tiles and a big pointer, with a game controller in front of it

mediatabjump.tagline: Jump to the tab that's playing.
mediatabjump.problem: Something's playing in one of thirty tabs. Click the player in the volume flyout and land right on it.
bullets: Jumps to the exact tab, even in another window or screen
Edge, Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Opera and Vivaldi
A soft glow shows the card is clickable
Play, pause and skip work like always
No browser extension, nothing to sign in to
mediatabjump.alt: The Windows volume flyout with a glowing now-playing card, and an arrow to the browser tab that is playing

autozoom.tagline: A zoom level per app, for big and small windows.
autozoom.problem: Set how zoomed in each app is when maximized and when not. AutoZoom switches as you resize.
bullets: Any app that zooms with Ctrl and +: Claude, Teams, Discord, VS Code, browsers
Each window keeps its own zoom
Different levels per screen, switching as you drag across
Set it all from the tray app, applied instantly
Only presses the app's own zoom keys, never reads the screen
autozoom.alt: The same app shown twice: maximized with larger text, and in a smaller window with text sized to fit

toolkit.tagline: Every tool behind one tray icon.
toolkit.problem: Every tool behind one tray icon, with quick switches and a settings page for each.
bullets: One click between Leanback and desktop mode
Controller speed, buttons and key combos without config files
Glow colours and AutoZoom levels with live preview
Light or dark, nine accent colours, three icon styles
Pause everything for an hour
toolkit.alt: The toolkit's tray menu: a Leanback mode card, tiles for Leanback Mode, Controller mouse, Media Tab Jump and Hover glow, and a Pause everything button
